markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 使役动词说的是**「让别人去做事」**。make 是逼着做，let 是允许做，help 是帮着做，get 是劝着做，have sth done 是**花钱请人帮你做**。

uses.en_zh: 老板逼着我加班到很晚。

make.title: make / let：不带 to
make.text: make 和 let 后面先放**人**，再放**动词原形**，中间**没有 to**。make 是不管你愿不愿意都得做；let 是你想做，我同意。

examples.en: Our manager [[lets]] us ((work)) from home on Fridays.
examples.zh: 经理允许我们周五在家办公。
需要什么就跟我说一声。

wrong.bad: My boss made me ~~to~~ work late.

help.title: help 和 get
help.text: **help** 后面带不带 to 都行，不带更常见。**get** 是「说服、劝动别人去做」，它后面**一定要有 to**。

items.zh: 你能帮我挪一下这张桌子吗？

items.rule: help 人 + to do 也行
items.en: This tool [[helps]] us [[to find]] bugs faster.
items.zh: 这个工具帮我们更快地找到 bug。

items.en: I finally [[got]] him [[to update]] the docs.
items.zh: 我终于让他把文档更新了。

items.en: Can you [[get]] Sam [[to call]] me back?
items.zh: 你能让萨姆给我回个电话吗？

done.title: have sth done：请人帮你做
done.text: 事情**不是你自己做的**，是请别人（常常是花钱）做的，就用 have 东西 done。东西放中间，最后是**过去分词**。

examples.zh: 下周我要请人把公寓刷一遍。

examples.en: We [[had]] the app [[tested]] by an outside company.
examples.zh: 我们请外面的公司测了这个 App。

notes: 倒霉的事也这么说：He [[had]] his phone [[stolen]] on the bus.（他在公交上手机被偷了。）
done.tip: get sth done 和 have sth done 意思一样，get 更口语。

commonMistakes.bad: I ~~repaired my car~~ at the garage.
commonMistakes.good: I [[had]] my car [[repaired]] at the garage.
commonMistakes.why: 修车的是修车师傅，不是你，用 have sth done。
东西放在 had 和 cut 中间。

quiz.prompt: I didn't cut it myself. I ___ yesterday.

traps.note: make 后面直接跟原形，没有 to。

quiz.prompt: 改错：She let me to go home early.
quiz.answer: She let me go home early.

quiz.prompt: ___ me know if you need anything.
翻译：这部电影把我看哭了。
Can you help me ___ this desk?
quiz.explain: help 人 + 原形（to move 也行）：help me ((move))。

quiz.prompt: I finally got him ___ (update) the docs.

traps.note: get 人后面一定要有 to。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Can you get Sam call me back?
quiz.answer: Can you get Sam to call me back?

quiz.prompt: We had the app ___ (test) by an outside company.
用 have sth done 改写：A painter is going to paint my flat next week.
quiz.answer: I'm having my flat painted next week.
accept: I am having my flat painted next week.
I'm going to have my flat painted next week.
I am going to have my flat painted next week.

quiz.prompt: 改错：I had my laptop repair last week.
quiz.answer: I had my laptop repaired last week.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：他在公交上手机被偷了。
quiz.answer: He had his phone stolen on the bus.
accept: He got his phone stolen on the bus.
quiz.explain: 倒霉的事也用 have sth done：[[had]] his phone [[stolen]]。

quiz.prompt: Mum ___ me stay up late. I was so happy!
Mum ___ me tidy my room. I didn't want to.
改错：I had cut my hair at the barber's.
quiz.answer: I had my hair cut at the barber's.
accept: I got my hair cut at the barber's.

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话：一句说小时候父母让你做或不让你做的事（make / let），一句说你劝动同事做了什么（get … to do），一句说你最近请人帮你做的事（have sth done）。
rules: make / let + 人 + 动词原形，中间没有 to；get + 人 + to do
have + 东西 + 过去分词，表示请别人做
openTask.note: 规则判使役动词后面的动词形式（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
